page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre ("IVDAICO"), page number top right. Below the head: a centred heading "TABULA PRIMA" and subtitle lines. Then a table with columns: "Anni ineuntes", "Radices noviluniorum" (fer., hor., scrup.), with "Emb." marks in the left margin. To the right of the table, a column of running text. Below the text block at right, a catchword-like signature "TAB. SECVN."

main_text.head: TABULA PRIMA.
main_text.p: Cyclus Lunæ primus in Periodo Iudaica, Radices Lunæ continens.
In hoc cyclo notantur anni non absoluti sed anni ineuntes.
Primus annus Iudeorum coepit an Periodi Iulianæ 953. die septima Octobris; quæ dies erat æquinoctii & novilunii simul, juxta abacum Ptolemaicum, Annis 3761. ante Epocham Christianā.
Isto anno 953. cyclus Solis fuit primus, & ut Iudæis placuit, cyclus Lunæ primus.
Horā partiuntur Iudei, Chaldei, & Arabes in scrupula 1080. quorum 18. æquantur uni sexagesimæ parti. Istę horarum partes ab ipsis vocantur Helakim.

page.notes: The "Emb." marks in the left margin are side notes beside rows 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18 and 19; they are printed as "Emb." and are recorded here rather than in the main text. Faint show-through from the reverse page (table fragments) is ignored. Table cells are shown separated by " | " as printed; the column of years and the scrupula values may be imperfectly read.
